CB: Companion of The Order of the Bath
DSO**: Distinguished Service Order and Two Bars
GCB: Knight Grand Cross of The Order of the Bath
KCVO: Knight Commander of the Royal Victorian Order
KStJ: Knight of the Order of Saint John
MBE: Member of the Order of the British Empire
OBE: Officer of the Order of the British Empire
OStJ: Officer of the Order of Saint John

AE: Awarded for ten years' efficient service in the Royal Auxiliary Air Force
AFC: Awarded for "an act or acts of valour, courage or devotion to duty whilst flying, though not in active operations against the enemy".
CDeG: A military decoration of both France and Belgium, also commonly bestowed to foreign military forces allied to France and Belgium.
CdeL: A decoration of France awarded for very meritorious conduct with the Free French Forces during World War II.
CdeLd'H: A decoration of France awarded for excellent civil or military conduct delivered, upon official investigation.
CdeLL: Awarded to Belgian nationals or some distinguished foreign persons who made very important contributions to the Belgian state or society.
DFC: Awarded to Royal Air Force commissioned officers and Warrant Officers for "an act or acts of valour, courage or devotion to duty whilst flying in active operations against the enemy".{{Citation needed|date=April 2011}}
DFC*: A bar is added to the ribbon for holders of the DFC who received a second award.
DFC**: A second bar is added to the ribbon for holders of the DFC and Bar who received a third award.
DFM: Awarded to military below commissioned rank, for "an act or acts of valour, courage or devotion to duty whilst flying in active operations against the enemy".{{Citation needed|date=April 2011}}
DSO: Awarded for meritorious or distinguished service by officers of the armed forces during wartime, typically in actual combat.
DSO*: A bar is added to the ribbon for holders of the DSO who received a second award.
DSO**: A second bar is added to the ribbon for holders of the DSO and Bar who received a third award.
KCVO: Awarded for personal service to the sovereign
KZ: Awarded for exemplary public service or humanitarian work that goes above and beyond the call of duty.
MC: Awarded for "an act or acts of exemplary gallantry during active operations against the enemy on land to all members, of any rank".{{Citation needed|date=April 2011}}
MM: Awarded for acts of gallantry and devotion to duty under fire
VC: Highest British military decoration, awarded for valour in the face of the enemy.
VM: Highest Polish military award for courage in the face of the enemy.
